messages:
Anna R: Hey @people-ops — urgent: I have a telemed visit with an out-of-network specialist in 2 hours. Provider is asking for proof of insurance + member ID. I can't find my physical or digital ID card. Can you help with a temporary proof?
people-ops-bot: Digital ID cards are available in the Benefits Portal: https://benefits.redwood.com/idcard (also check the Redwood mobile wallet). If you need a one-off letter we can issue one — tag the team below.
Ben M: Hey Anna — we can generate a one-time PDF you can show at check-in. Can you DM me full name + DOB + last 4 of SSN? If you prefer not to share SSN here, DM is fine. :+1:
Anna R: DM'd the details (Anna Rivera, 1991-06-12, last4 1234). Thanks!
Ben M: Got it. Sending temporary proof to your work email now (subject: "Redwood - Temporary Proof of Coverage"). It contains member ID, plan name, and effective dates. That PDF usually works for telemed/check-in. :white_check_mark:
Emily S: FYI if they only need the member ID, you can also show the Member # from the carrier profile (Benefits Portal → Profile → ID card). I used that for an out-of-network urgent care last month.
Juan P: One more tip: for faster handling the provider can call our carrier at `1-800-555-2525` and reference employer code `REDW-42` to pre-authorize telemed claims. Saves a lot of back-and-forth.
Anna R: I got the email, PDF looks good and has the member #. Quick Q — if they charge me upfront, should I pay and then file a claim?
Ben M: If they require payment, pay and get an itemized receipt (date, CPT/visit code, tax ID). After the visit submit a claim through the carrier portal (link included in the PDF) and attach the receipt. If anything is denied, reply here or email benefits@redwood.com and we can help escalate.
Anna R: Saved the PDF to my phone wallet and sent to the provider. Heading into the visit now — really appreciate the quick help, thanks everyone. :pray:
people-ops-bot: Case #PO-2026-1987 created for Anna R — Ben M assigned as owner. For urgent assistance call Benefits ext. 4321 during business hours.
